author: Alpp
body: Hi Alpp Here I was wondering if I could get unbanned. I was very stupid and decided to hack about half a year ago and for that reason was banned from many servers including avicus. I am so sorry for what i have done and how I have ruined the gameplay of many avicus players playing at that certain time. Avicus being an amazing server, I would like to make an appeal so that I could hopefully get unbanned. This is an amazing server and thought that I should just make an appeal already and play legitimately in game with me and my friends. I would really love it if that could happen for this is such an amazing server and for me to get banned on it has made me feel worse and worse while all my friends are enjoying the experience of playing on such a good server like this. Please may this happen because I absolutely love this server and would hate for me to miss out on any more of the gameplay. Thankyou. My IGN is Alpp.

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hey Alpp,

Since you have been banned for quite a while I have decided to give you another chance and appeal your ban.
Please update yourself with the rules as they may have changed a bit since your last time on avicus. 

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator
